scope: City of Buffalo / Buffalo Water; excludes Erie County Water Authority replacement totals

inventory.limits: Published material classifications, not tap-test results or a live remaining count. August 2024 footer is a template revision. Do not sum utility/customer segments or subtract earlier program counts. Unknown is not confirmed lead.

milestones.finding: ROLL launch: 30 homes replaced since June; approximately 180 initially planned
ARPA expansion completed at more than 700 residential properties; $10 million initiative
milestones.limit: Expansion count, not all-time city total; do not add separately mentioned earlier 500 homes

milestones.finding: 25 services replaced in October; board will stop accepting new no-cost ROLL applications
milestones.limit: Not a finding that all replacement work stopped

milestones.finding: $1,092,000 federal funding announced for Buffalo lead service-line replacement
milestones.limit: Award announcement, not completed replacements or proof general free applications reopened; broad 40,000–60,000 estimate not substituted for classified state inventory

monitoring.finding: 82 of 100 required approved lead-and-copper samples submitted; monitoring violation
monitoring.limit: Sampling shortfall is not itself evidence of an action-level exceedance

policyConflict.finding: Undated FAQ describes no-cost replacement in certain circumstances; dated November 2025 minutes announce new-application cutoff
policyConflict.response: Tell residents to confirm current eligibility, costs, scope and schedule; do not promise free replacements

history.finding: 1827 wooden-pipe beginnings; 1852 river pumping; 1868 city purchase; 1913 Lake Erie intake; 1914 chlorination; 1926 treatment plant
history.limit: System milestones do not establish installation dates or manufacturers of current lead service lines

healthLimits: No safe childhood blood-lead level. No conversion of pipe counts into child exposure, blood-lead levels or predicted developmental outcomes.
